name: Codex ExecPlan living validation loop
decision: KRN long-running implementation should keep detailed objective, discoveries, decisions, validation, next work, and compactness rules in PLANS.md, while PLAN.md remains the compact product truth.
falsifier: A fresh continuation cannot recover the active task, discoveries, validation state, and next work from compact root files plus PLANS.md without broad historical rereads.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove PLANS.md should retain raw logs forever, that every old decision remains current, or that plan hygiene alone creates product value.
